description.zh: Firecrawl：网页抓取、搜索与内容解析（免密额度有限）
description.en: Firecrawl: web scraping, search and content parsing (limited free quota)

description.zh: Tavily：面向 AI 的联网搜索、抓取与研究
description.en: Tavily: web search, scraping and research for AI

description.zh: GitHub：仓库、issue、PR 与代码检索
description.en: GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests and code search

help.zh: GitHub 个人访问令牌，需包含要访问的仓库与组织权限。
help.en: GitHub personal access token with permission for the repositories and organizations you want to access.

description.zh: DeepWiki：GitHub 仓库的 AI 文档与问答
description.en: DeepWiki: AI docs and Q&A for GitHub repositories

description.zh: Context7：查询最新的库与框架文档
description.en: Context7: up-to-date library and framework docs

description.zh: Sentry：错误、性能与项目数据
description.en: Sentry: errors, performance and project data

description.zh: Vercel：项目、部署与运行日志
description.en: Vercel: projects, deployments and runtime logs

description.zh: Cloudflare：账户 API 与开发者文档
description.en: Cloudflare: account APIs and developer docs

description.zh: Supabase：项目、数据库与日志
description.en: Supabase: projects, databases and logs

description.zh: Notion：页面、数据库与工作区内容
description.en: Notion: pages, databases and workspace content

description.zh: Atlassian：Jira 与 Confluence
description.en: Atlassian: Jira and Confluence

description.zh: Microsoft Learn：微软官方文档检索
description.en: Microsoft Learn: official Microsoft documentation search

description.zh: Hugging Face：模型、数据集与 Spaces
description.en: Hugging Face: models, datasets and Spaces

description.zh: Linear：issue、项目与团队协作
description.en: Linear: issues, projects and team collaboration

description.zh: Stripe：客户、支付与账单
description.en: Stripe: customers, payments and billing

description.zh: PayPal：发票、订单与交易
description.en: PayPal: invoices, orders and transactions

description.zh: Zapier：通过 Zap 调用数千个应用的 action
description.en: Zapier: call thousands of app actions through Zaps

help.zh: 在 Zapier MCP 服务器的 Settings 页生成 API token。
help.en: Generate an API token on the Settings page of the Zapier MCP server.

description.zh: 高德地图：地理编码、路线与周边搜索
description.en: Amap: geocoding, routing and nearby search

help.zh: 高德开放平台的 Web 服务 API Key。
help.en: Web service API key from the Amap open platform.

description.zh: 百度地图：地理编码、路线与地点检索
description.en: Baidu Maps: geocoding, routing and place search

help.zh: 百度地图开放平台的服务器端 AK，并勾选 MCP 服务。
help.en: Server-side AK from the Baidu Maps open platform; enable the MCP service for it.

description.zh: 瑞幸咖啡：门店查询、选品、下单与取餐码
description.en: Luckin Coffee: shop lookup, menu search, ordering and pickup code

help.zh: 在瑞幸 AI 开放平台登录后复制 Bearer Key，有效期约 1 个月，过期需重新获取。
help.en: Log in to the Luckin AI open platform and copy the Bearer key. It stays valid for about a month; get a new one when it expires.
